All cooling water pipes, valves, and equipment with accessible surface temperatures exceeding 60°C (HT circuit: typically 70–95°C) shall be thermally insulated to reduce surface temperature below 55°C at 25°C ambient (typical class requirement).
Insulation material shall be mineral wool (rock wool / glass wool) or equivalent with maximum service temperature ≥ 150°C, with aluminium or stainless steel cladding for mechanical protection in areas exposed to splash or foot traffic.
Insulation shall not be applied to flanges, valves, instrumentation connections, or items requiring periodic inspection — these shall have removable insulation covers.
High-temperature surfaces that cannot be fully insulated (e.g., valve bonnets, pump casings) shall have ISO 11684-compliant 'Hot Surface' warning signs affixed at intervals ≤ 2 m in accessible areas.
Cooling water pipelines shall be color-coded per ISO 14726 (or ship-specific standard): HT cooling water — green + letter code; seawater — green with specific stripe; freshwater — green.
Major cooling system equipment shall carry nameplates with tag number, system designation, and maintenance interval.

E-HT-PRESS-009:
The components for circulation and temperature regulation in the low temperature circuit are placed in the internal system for the L21/31 engine (Tier II, one string).  
The charge air cooler and the lubricating oil cooler are situated in serial order in the low temperature circuit.  
After the LT water has passed the lubricating oil cooler, it is led to the thermostatic valve, and depending on the water temperature, the water will either be re-circulated or led to the external system.  
The built-on engine-driven HT circulating pump of the centrifugal type pumps water through the first stage of the charge air cooler and then through the distributing bore to the bottom of the cooling water jacket in the high temperature circuit.  
The water is led out through bores at the top of the cooling water jacket to the bore in the cylinder head for cooling of the cylinder head, the exhaust valve seats, and the injector valve.

E-COOLER-CLEAN-012:
Box cooler可作为板式或管式中央冷却器的替代方案安装。  
Box冷却原理非常简单：冷却水被强制通过一个置于海水箱中的U型管束，该海水箱设有进口和出口格栅。  
冷却效果通过周围海水的自然循环实现：舷外水被加热后因密度降低而上升，从而形成向上的自然循环流，带走热量。  
Box冷却的优点是不需要原水系统，且箱式冷却器不易结垢，因此特别适用于浅水或浑浊水域。
E-COOLER-INST-007: 中央冷却器选型要求：对于L21/31和L27/38机型，在柴油-电力推进系统中，海水在热交换器中的流动由受热海水因密度低于周围水而向上运动所驱动。这意味着与安装在船壳上的冷却器相比，热交换对船舶速度的依赖性较低。然而，船舶速度对冷却面积确实有一定影响。对于在最大持续功率（MCR）下航速低于3节的船舶（如拖船、挖泥船等），在设计冷却器时必须考虑航速。海水温度也会影响热交换器的效率。建议根据船舶作业区域使用25°C或32°C的温度。

E-VALVE-PRESS-015:
The small ø3 bore in the non-return valve disc enables the auxiliary engine to keep the recommended cooling water temperature in the HT-system during low load operation, which is essential for the combustion of HFO.  
Preheating of stand-by auxiliary engines and propulsion engines during harbour operation is achieved by utilizing hot water from the auxiliary engines.  
Depending on the size of propulsion engine and auxiliary engines, an extra preheater may be necessary.  
This preheating is activated by closing valve A and opening valve B.

主机冷却型式与设计条件：Tier II 机型在参考条件（热带）下无需降额，若超出以下限值则需特殊计算。
涡轮增压器前空气温度 Tx ≤ 318 K (45 °C)（标准）/ 333 K (60 °C)（特殊）。
环境压力 ≥ 100 kPa (1 bar)（标准）/ 90 kPa（特殊）。
冷却水温度（低温级中冷器进口）≤ 311 K (38 °C)（标准）/ 316 K (43 °C)（特殊）。
压缩机前进气压力 ≥ -20 mbar（标准）/ -40 mbar（特殊），表压。
涡轮增压器后排气背压 ≤ 30 mbar（标准）/ 60 mbar（特殊），表压。
降额修正系数：POperating = PApplication, ISO × [1.09 - 0.09 × (Tx / a)]，其中 a 为环境条件修正因子。
Tx 为涡轮增压器前空气温度 [K]（Tx = 273 + tx）。
